title: Billiken Bungalow Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutBilliken Bungalow ~ 320 Forest Street ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off thru June 26th! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed by a June 27th departure. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Late Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays starting July 11th and completed by August 9th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Perfect for multi-generational family vacations, Billiken Bungalow is a beautiful, well-appointed and lovingly maintained home with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 baths, sleeping 10 guests. Leisurely 3-block walk takes you to the Dogwood/Thyme beach access. 12'x24' private heated pool (heating fee applies). With 3,914 sf (2,820 interior), Billken Bungalow offers a spacious interior, large bedrooms, separate adult/child living areas, an amazingly well-equipped kitchen and a wonderful screened porch overlooking the pool. On-street parking is not allowed; please note parking spaces below and plan accordingly. Billiken Bungalow is the 3rd house outside Seaside - so just a very short walk to explore this internationally recognized New Urbanism community (shopping and all events on the Town Center are free to the public!). Tucked away in Old Seagrove, Billiken Bungalow is a fantastic house with a fantastic location - which is why guests come back year after year! Ground Floor: 1 bedroom. 1 full bath. Powder room. Living room. Dining table seats 8. Bar seating for 4. Fully equipped kitchen. Laundry room. Enclosed outdoor shower. Screened Porch. *Please note - fireplace is decorative only and not for guest use. #1 En-suite bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, separate jetted tub, double vanity. Second Floor: Kids den. Kitchenette. 3 bedrooms. 3 baths. Covered porch. #2 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, Pack-n-Play in closet. #3 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower. #4 Bedroom has 2 Bunks (4 twins) Full Bath with tub/shower Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured), 2 work desk Entertainment Features 6 Smart TVs, 2 Blu-Ray/DVD players, stereo, board games, puzzles, books, movies (Please note - no local channels; streaming services available on Smart TVs with guests personal login credentials). Distinctive Features Private heated pool (heating fee applies) Steps into Seaside 2 blocks to neighborhood beach access 2 living rooms Bed, bath, kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 4 vehicles, 3 King beds, 2 Bunks (4 Twins), Pack-n-Play, 4 full bathrooms, 1 powder room, 2 work desks, iron, ironing board, 4 hairdryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, enclosed outdoor shower, outdoor porches, porch furniture, pack-n-play. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Also, guests do not have access to poolside storage cottage. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, coffee maker, Keurig, gas range, refrigerator with ice dispenser, separate ice machine, 2 microwaves, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer, 2nd FL mini fridge. Area Features TimpoocheeTrail (30A bike path) Seaside (100 yards) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
